_comment: Tier-2 for fourc::structural_dynamics#8 — the structural time loop stops at whichever of NUMSTEP and MAXTIME is reached first, and the early stop is silent (exit 0, no warning). Same deck three ways: TIMESTEP 0.1 / NUMSTEP 100 / MAXTIME 0.3 runs 3 of the requested 100 steps and ends on 'Finalised step 3 / 100'; TIMESTEP 0.1 / NUMSTEP 3 / MAXTIME 100 ends on 'Finalised step 3 / 3'; MAXTIME 0 executes the loop body zero times, prints no step line at all, and still exits 0. Verified by execution 2026-08-03 against 4C 2026.2.0-dev (git 89519cf).
